notes.title: Waking Tides: Awards, Major Update & Free Demo Available
notes.content:
After receiving [i]silver [/i]at the Belgian Game Awards we are thrilled to announce a significant update for Waking Tides, bringing new features and improvements for a better player experience:


[list]
 [list]
 [b]Full Controller Support[/b]
[*] Now fully compatible with all major controllers, delivering a smooth and intuitive gameplay experience.

 [b]Achievement System[/b]
[*] A range of in-game achievements has been introduced, offering new goals and rewards to challenge and engage players as they progress through the game.

[b]Performance Enhancements[/b]
 [*] Optimized for faster load times and improved performance across all platforms, ensuring a more stable and fluid gaming experience.

[b]Free Demo[/b]
[*]Not ready to commit? Try Waking Tides for free! Our newly released demo gives you a taste of the game’s unique world and AR mechanics. [/list]
[/list]

Jump in today to experience the new features and get a first look with the free demo!
